card.name: Linking words before art institutions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, in, at, to, de, 's) right before the name of a school, museum or studio in art and dance biographies. The next word is expected to be a named institution or place.

modes.label: Preposition before school or museum
modes.description: Words like at, in, the or to just before a named art school, studio or museum.
modes.example: Ballet School. That same year he left for London to study at<< the>> Sadler’s Wells school, later joining

modes.label: Possessive or 'de' in institution names
modes.description: A 's or de inside the name of a London or French institute.
modes.example: Dr. Bruno Lopez of the Observatoire<< de>> la Cote d'Azur,

card.writes: Little clear effect; it slightly favors words like master and Fi, as in names of institutions.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the name of an art school, museum or studio.
